integrity: The all-parameter proof uses the complete facet system verified in both primary same-object papers. Projected Euclidean facet normals yield two sharp universal inradius bounds; equality cases classify every center and identify a homothetic Birkhoff polytope. A vertex-barycenter identity independently certifies the unique outer sphere. Numerical linear programs and exhaustive small vertex enumerations are corroborative, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for square k-assignment polytopes with N>=3 and 2<=k<N in the intrinsic Frobenius metric of the fixed-total affine hull. The endpoint and rectangular cases, general bipartite graphs, and extremal ellipsoids are not treated.
title: A Birkhoff-polytope family of incenters for partial assignment polytopes
